items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: Sonny Fortune and I was playing in Italy one night... Just the two of us — saxophone and drums.

ctx.x: They would get so religious and so carried away with the music until sometimes they would just faint, fall out, and then they would go start babbling [scats] stuff that you didn’t even know what they were and sometimes they would have like a seizure and foam would be coming out of their mouth. And I mean that was very intense stuff. And even it didn’t matter what age they were, I mean it’d be from older people to little kids who were actually — you know something like that happened to me when I was in Italy one…
Okay. And did they have another term for it, like, you know, Doris got the spirit or something?
